answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral in an escrow and correlating equivocation across signed messages. If k coordinated identities equivocate, their joint penalty scales as O(k^2); once a managed swarm is detected, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making fabricated voting power economically self-defeating. Thus atlas, fable, and canyon remain labels, not cheap consensus weight.
